The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Vodal Kressh]] gathered an '''army of followers''' in order to use against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] led by [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]], though he died before putting any of his plans into action. His followers remained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]] over the following centuries, however. Their ranks included warriors, [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]], and [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]].<ref name="TOR" />

By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] thousands of years later, it was rumored that the Republic had [[Mission to Athiss|destroyed]] Kressh and his followers, but that a dark cult still protected his tomb.<ref name="FaD CRB">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
